blocks.text: Mean, jise average (ausat) bhi kehte hain, central tendency (data ka markaz) ka aik paimana hai jo batata hai ke data ki beech wali qeemat taqreeban kitni hai. Biology mein yeh bare data ko aik markazi qeemat mein samet deta hai jo aam khasiyat dikhati hai, jaise ausat size ya ausat growth rate (barhne ki raftaar).
Ungrouped data (alag alag qeematein) ke liye:

items: Σx = tamam qeematon ka jama (sum). Σ (sigma) ka matlab hai 'sab ko jama karo'.
n = data mein qeematon ki tadaad.

blocks.text: Grouped data (classes mein baante gaye data) ke liye:

items: xᵢ = ith class interval ka midpoint (beech ki qeemat).
fᵢ = ith class ki frequency (kitni baar aayi).

blocks.title: Mean nikalne ke qadam (ungrouped data)
blocks.problem: Aik biologist ne park mein aik hi species ke paanch parindon ka wazan (g) record kiya: 400g, 420g, 470g, 390g aur 460g. Ausat wazan kya hai?
steps: Qadam 2: parindon ki kul tadaad ginein (n).
Qadam 3: wazan ke jama ko parindon ki tadaad se taqseem (divide) karein.
blocks.answer: Is species ke parindon ka ausat wazan 428 g hai.

blocks.title: Mean nikalne ke qadam (grouped data)
blocks.problem: Aik biologist ne mukhtalif mitti (soil) wale khaiton mein aik paude ki growth parhi. Paudon ki unchaiyan (cm) class intervals mein jama ki gayi hain.
steps: Qadam 1: data ko class intervals mein tarteeb dein.
Qadam 2: har class interval ka midpoint nikalein: (nichli had + oopri had) / 2.
Qadam 3: har midpoint ko us ki frequency se zarb (multiply) dein.
Qadam 4: in tamam hasil-e-zarb (products) ko jama karein.
Qadam 5: qadam 4 ke jawab ko kul frequency se taqseem karein.

blocks.caption: Grouped data se paudon ki ausat unchai (cm) ka hisaab (kitab ka table, total sahih)

blocks.text: Kitab ke table ki aakhri qatar par 'Median' likha hai aur Σfᵢxᵢ = 4601 chhapa hai. Yeh qatar asal mein total (kul) hai: Σfᵢ = 24 aur Σfᵢxᵢ = 25 + 120 + 175 + 140 = 460. Kitab ka apna hisaab bhi 460 hi istemal karta hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Yani mukhtalif mitti mein is paude ki ausat growth (unchai) 19.17 cm hai.

Grouped data mein har paude ki asal unchai maloom nahi, sirf class maloom hai. Is liye har class ke sab paudon ko us class ke midpoint ke barabar maan lete hain; fᵢxᵢ us class ke paudon ki 'kul unchai' ka andaza hai.
